answer: To forge duplicate identities, an attacker must acquire fresh keys and pay that burn for every fake agent, while honest peers cross-check a rotating lantern of signed attestations. Each agent must stake a velvet token bonded to a unique hardware key and burn a small fee per epoch. Sybil cost scales linearly with fake identity count, making mass duplication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
